name: smwpatches-yoshi-sprites-interaction-fix-v1
title: Yoshi Sprites Interaction Fix v1.1
description:
This simple patch fixes a couple weird behaviors that happen while riding Yoshi:
- Getting damaged by kicked throw blocks.
- Getting damaged by Dry Bones and Bony Beetles in the crumbled state.
v1.1:
- Getting damaged by stationary Bowser Statues.
- Getting damaged by Boo Blocks (while in block state).
